Live in three steps

No code, no design skills. If you can fill a form, you can build this page.

1

Claim your username

Sign up with email and grab your name before someone else does. Your address becomes buraqbio.link/u/name.

2

Add your profile & links

Add your photo or logo, a short intro, then your links. Drag them into the order you want — top link gets the most taps.

3

Share it everywhere

Paste your one link into Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and WhatsApp. Watch the click counters to learn what people love.

Builder pack: images, icons & copy map

Everything on this page is yours to reuse in the repo. Download each file below, drop it in an images/ folder in your project, and copy the homepage section by section using the map. Gold is used only where the brand allows it: badges, prices and focus rings.

1 · Hero covers — download these

Two wide covers, both 2000px+. Hero cover 1 is the abstract glass art used behind the phone in the hero. Hero cover 2 is the creators photo used in the Examples section and as a sharing image.

Hero Cover 1 — Glass Phone  hero-cover-main.webp

Use in: hero section background / phone cover strip. 2240 × 1120.

Download .webp
Hero Cover 2 — Creators  hero-cover-creators.webp

Use in: Examples section, social sharing (og:image). 2352 × 1008.

Download .webp
Example Avatar — Bakery  avatar-bakery.webp

Use in: the phone preview as the sample business logo. Replace with the user's real photo/logo in your build. 1600 × 1600.

Download .webp
Favicon — Golden Wing  favicon.webp

Use in: browser tab. Golden wing on a deep purple tile — readable even at 16px.

Download .webp

2 · Icon set — download each SVG

One stroke style, 1.8px, Metro Purple. Use them at 20–34px. In your own code you can paste the SVG inline instead of using an <img>, so you can recolor it with CSS.

3 · Layout copy map — build it in this order

Each row is one block of index.html, top to bottom, with the tag and class names used on this page. Copy one block, style it, check it on your phone, then move down.

1
Sticky nav<header class="topbar">

Glass dark bar. Logo left (horizontal wing lockup — logo-wing-horizontal-light.webp), 3 links center, Log in + Create button right. Collapses to a Menu button under 900px.

2
Hero<section class="hero">

Deep Start background, 2-column grid. Left: pill, H1, one-line pitch, username claim form, 3 tick points. Right: glass phone preview. Stacks to 1 column on mobile.

3
Phone preview.phone.glass

Cover image, round avatar overlapping it, name, handle, intro, link buttons with click-count chips, gold FEATURED product card (Phase 1.2 teaser).

4
How it works<section id="how">

Light Paper background. H2 + one sub-line + 3 numbered steps. Big light-weight numbers in Metro Purple — the Windows 8 touch.

5
Features<section id="features">

Left: one large dark panel showing the reorder list + Copy button demo. Right: 2×2 small white cards, one icon each. Phase 1 features only.

6
Examples<section id="examples">

Creators cover photo left, 3 example profiles right (avatar, name, one-line story, their URL). Social proof without fake numbers.

7
Username checker.checker

White card, form left-aligned with prefix text. Shows the 3 states your signup needs: available (green), taken and invalid (red).

8
CTA + footer.cta / .home-foot

One glass card on Deep Start with a Metro Purple button and a gold badge above it — gold stays on badges, prices and focus rings only. Footer: one line + 4 links, nothing more.

4 · CSS starter — paste into your style.css

The exact variables, glass recipe and buttons from this page and your locked brand guide. One copy, and every page (login, signup, dashboard) stays on brand.

Brand variables + glass + buttons
/* BuraqBio — brand system (locked) */
:root{
  --primary:#603CBA;   /* Metro Purple — buttons, links */
  --deep:#1C0B45;      /* Deep Start — dark backgrounds */
  --violet:#B7A6FF;    /* Secondary — links on dark */
  --gold:#FFB900;      /* Accent — prices, badges, focus ONLY */
  --ink:#1B1030; --muted:#5C5670; --paper:#F5F2FA;
  --wa:#25D366;        /* WhatsApp buttons only */
  --error:#D92B3A;     /* Form errors only */
}
body{font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper)}
.glass{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(160%);border-radius:20px}
.btn{background:var(--primary);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;
  padding:12px 20px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
